hsi_probe_monthly_records = {
	if = { limit = { OR = { c:BIC = this c:BOL = this c:DAI = this c:EGY = this c:FRA = this c:GBR = this c:HAI = this c:MAD = this c:NET = this c:PAN = this c:PER = this c:RUS = this c:SIA = this c:SPA = this } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = hsi_sample } } set_variable = { name = hsi_sample value = 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = hsi_sample add = 1 }
		if = { limit = { var:hsi_sample <= 3 }
			set_global_variable = { name = hsi_g_sample value = var:hsi_sample }
			set_global_variable = { name = hsi_g_root_unrec value = hsi_probe_unrec }
			if = { limit = { c:GBR = this }
				c:GBR ?= {
					set_global_variable = { name = hsi_g_gpop value = global_population }
					set_global_variable = { name = hsi_g_ggdp value = global_gdp }
				}
				debug_log = "HSI;monthly;[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_sample').GetValue|0];[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString];GLOBAL;-;pop=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_gpop').GetValue|0];gdp=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_ggdp').GetValue|2]"
				s:STATE_ADANA.region_state:EGY ?= {
					hsi_probe_state_globals = yes
					debug_log = "HSI;monthly;[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_sample').GetValue|0];[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString];STATE;STATE_ADANA/EGY;owner_type=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_ot').GetValue|0];pop=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_pop').GetValue|0];gdp=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_gdp').GetValue|2];pop_share_uncapped=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_pshare').GetValue|4];gdp_share_uncapped=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_gshare').GetValue|4];incorporated=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_inc').GetValue|0];capital=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_cap').GetValue|0];owner_homeland=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_oh').GetValue|0];base=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_base').GetValue|4]"
				}
				s:STATE_ALEPPO.region_state:EGY ?= {
					hsi_probe_state_globals = yes
					debug_log = "HSI;monthly;[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_sample').GetValue|0];[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString];STATE;STATE_ALEPPO/EGY;owner_type=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_ot').GetValue|0];pop=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_pop').GetValue|0];gdp=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_gdp').GetValue|2];pop_share_uncapped=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_pshare').GetValue|4];gdp_share_uncapped=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_gshare').GetValue|4];incorporated=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_inc').GetValue|0];capital=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_cap').GetValue|0];owner_homeland=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_oh').GetValue|0];base=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_base').GetValue|4]"
				}
				s:STATE_ALGIERS.region_state:FRA ?= {
					hsi_probe_state_globals = yes
					debug_log = "HSI;monthly;[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_sample').GetValue|0];[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString];STATE;STATE_ALGIERS/FRA;owner_type=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_ot').GetValue|0];pop=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_pop').GetValue|0];gdp=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_gdp').GetValue|2];pop_share_uncapped=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_pshare').GetValue|4];gdp_share_uncapped=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_gshare').GetValue|4];incorporated=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_inc').GetValue|0];capital=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_cap').GetValue|0];owner_homeland=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_oh').GetValue|0];base=[GetGlobalVariable('hsi_g_base').GetValue|4]"
				}
